assets.statement: explicit 4-periodic walk over S={e1,e2} satisfies all frozen premises yet its four-point image (unit square vertices) has no three collinear points; canonical statement is false as frozen and must be re-frozen with an injectivity/unboundedness premise before either branch can close nontrivially

Refuted: for m=κ=(2^ℵ₀)+, colouring by stationary partition of sup A (Solovay) plus the club C_X of countable sups of any unbounded X makes every X∈[κ]^κ see all κ colours, so the canonical statement holds at m=κ and the proposed negative close fails; full-scope affirmative (all infinite m) remains

A=ℝ satisfies the frozen premise (infinite subset of ℝ) but defeats the conclusion, since every affine image aA+b is all of ℝ and no proper E contains it; the canonical universal statement is false as written and requires an added smallness hypothesis on A.

L1 = "record bounds 5≤min s≤10^7 close Branch A" fails: minimal case k=5 — no ∀-side obstruction for min s specifically, quantifier slip confirmed, and the route continues only by renaming the difficulty (§4.1 circularity); repair = explicit m with colouring witness s≤m plus universal (m−1)-term blu

2-periodic walk 0↔e1 with S={±e1} is a valid infinite S-walk with |A|=2: refutes the distinct-points reading; the literal reading is vacuously true via coincident triples, so the frozen statement needs a distinctness/self-avoidance repair before any close.

The Bool-valued check is a closed-form certificate generator: `multiplicity n d ≤ 2` on every chord-distance class d ∈ [1, ⌊n/2⌋] certifies the premise for EVERY centre x_i and EVERY radius r > 0 (each vertex-to-vertex distance is realized by at most 2 other vertices, so no circle centred at a vertex contains 3 other points — the contract's problem-specific trap is discharged by the all-radii argument, not by checking special radii); `(List.range (n/2)).length = ⌊n/2⌋` is the exact distinct-distance count D = ⌊n/2⌋; and `2·⌊n/2⌋ ≤ n < (1+c)·n` for every real c > 0 gives the strict violation D
